executive_summary: Established an API-first authorization gate and metadata framework for Shopee and Lazada. Automated anti-bot bypassing, CAPTCHA solving, and credential persistence are strictly forbidden. Providers are maintained in user_authorization_required status until official developer app keys are connected through runtime environment variables.
key_findings: Defined non-secret provider connection metadata in config/provider_connections.json for Shopee Open Platform and Lazada Open Platform
Implemented API authorization and smoke test validation in scripts/provider_api.py
Verified via automated test suite (Test 16): unauthorized providers remain blocked and API payloads reject secret tokens
Strictly enforced safety boundaries: zero keys, tokens, cookies, or tax data stored in the repository
risks: Portal scraping triggers aggressive anti-bot rate-limiting and account suspension; official API credentials are mandatory for programmatic scale.
questions_for_lead: Does Lead prefer registering for official Shopee Open Platform developer credentials, or proceeding with manual link generation via the affiliate portal?
next_task_suggestions: If API keys are obtained, provide via runtime environment variables (e.g. SHOPEE_APP_ID, SHOPEE_API_SECRET)
Otherwise, proceed with human operator manual link generation using docs/AFFILIATE_ONBOARDING_GUIDE.md
